2609.09672.title: SEA-SpeechBench: A Large-Scale Multitask Benchmark for Speech Understanding Across Southeast Asia
2609.09672.paper_summary: The rapid advancement of audio and multimodal large language models has unlocked transformative speech understanding capabilities, yet evaluation frameworks remain predominantly English-centric, leaving Southeast Asian (SEA) languages critically underrepresented. We introduce SEA-SpeechBench, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multitask benchmark that evaluates speech understanding in 11 SEA languages through 97,194 samples across 99 evaluation sets and 597 hours of curated audio data. Our benchmark comprises 9 diverse tasks across 3 categories: speech processing (automatic speech recognition, speech translation, spoken question answering), paralinguistic analysis (emotion, gender, age, speaker recognition), and temporal understanding, a novel dimension featuring timestamped content queries and temporal localization within extended audio sequences up to 3 minutes. We implement multilingual prompting in both native SEA languages and English to reflect user interactions with audio-language models. Evaluation of leading open-source and proprietary systems reveals marked performance gaps. Across all models, performance remains underwhelming on temporal understanding, emotion recognition, and speech translation. Prompting in low-resource languages such as Burmese and Tamil lags behind English by up to 41 percentage points. Our findings expose critical model limitations and underscore the need for inclusive model development. The SEA-SpeechBench benchmark is available at https://zwenyu.github.io/SEA-SpeechBench/.
2609.09672.paper_summary_zh: 音頻和多模態大型語言模型的迅速進展解鎖了變革性的語音理解能力，但評估框架仍然主要以英語為中心，導致東南亞（SEA）語言的代表性嚴重不足。我們推出了SEA-SpeechBench，據我們所知，這是第一個大規模的多任務基準，通過97,194個樣本和99個評估集以及597小時的精選音頻數據來評估11種SEA語言的語音理解。我們的基準包含9個多樣化的任務，分為3個類別：語音處理（自動語音識別、語音翻譯、口語問答）、副語言分析（情感、性別、年齡、說話者識別）和時間理解，這是一個新穎的維度，特徵是帶有時間戳的內容查詢和在長達3分鐘的擴展音頻序列中的時間定位。我們在本地SEA語言和英語中實施多語言提示，以反映用戶與音頻語言模型的互動。對領先的開源和專有系統的評估顯示出明顯的性能差距。在所有模型中，時間理解、情感識別和語音翻譯的性能仍然不盡人意。在資源匱乏的語言如緬甸語和泰米爾語中的提示表現落後於英語多達41個百分點。我們的發現揭示了模型的關鍵限制，並強調了包容性模型開發的必要性。SEA-SpeechBench基準可在https://zwenyu.github.io/SEA-SpeechBench/獲得。
